literal: rutting of elephant bull upon eye veil woman's unyielding breast upon cloth
translation: The garment covering this woman's firm breasts looks like the face-veil worn by a fierce, rutting elephant.
modern: இப்பெண்ணின் சாயாத மார்பகங்களின் மேல் அணிந்துள்ள ஆடையானது, மதம் பிடித்த ஆண் யானையின் கண்களை மறைக்கும் முகபடாம் போன்றது.
explanation: The speaker compares the garment over the young woman's firm breasts to the face-veil placed on a fierce, rutting elephant. Just as the veil on a rutting elephant signals its dangerous and overwhelming power, the cloth on her breasts highlights her captivating and devastating beauty. The word 'படாஅ' (unyielding or not sagging) emphasizes her youth and vitality. Through this striking martial imagery, the couplet conveys how her beauty completely overpowers his mind.
